en.title: UK Charities Warn Against Benefit Cuts for Disabled Youth
en.summary: More than 40 UK charities have urged ministers not to cut benefits for disabled young people, warning that stricter eligibility could remove support. Meanwhile, Tyler is deploying robots to assess ADA compliance in city infrastructure, and NYU Langone researchers have unveiled AI-powered tools to assist blind individuals. These developments highlight ongoing efforts to protect rights and improve accessibility through technology and policy.

zh-TW.title: 英國慈善反對削減殘障青年福利
zh-TW.summary: 超過40家英國慈善機構呼籲部長不要削減殘障青年福利，擔心更嚴格的資格審查會導致福利流失。同時，泰勒市使用機器人評估ADA合規性，紐約大學朗格尼團隊開發AI工具協助盲人無障礙。這些舉措顯示政策保護與技術創新並重的趨勢。
